notes: Purpose-built first-pass pack for manual validation with TwitterAPI.io credits in mind.
Run this pack before broad discovery so you can identify earliest credible amplifiers and then promote them into the watchlist.
Account-specific probes require at least one recent tweet hit; stale tweets older than 14 days are discarded to avoid false positives from ancient replies.
